meta.title: Thai language and voice input
meta.description: Adds ไทย through DSH's native locale service and includes customized dsh-voice in one bundle. Voice keeps its API/credential identity; migrate existing standalone settings once. It uses your configured transcription providers; cloud providers receive audio. Disable a previous standalone voice bundle before migrating. Microphone use requires permission and explicit start. Some third-party UI remains untranslated.
